mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_schedules (schedule_id, agent_id, start_date, end_date, is_available) VALUES ( agent_schedules_seq.NEXTVAL, #{agentId}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id, agent_id, start_date, end_date, is_available FROM agent_schedules WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY start_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_schedules SET is_available = 'N' WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND start_date <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{reservationDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND end_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{reservationDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
